projects.title: A warm, sunlit corporate office
projects.made: Reception counter, storage walls, workstations, boardroom table
projects.brief: A growing company wanted an office that felt calm and welcoming rather than corporate and cold — one that made the most of a floor with generous windows and garden views.
needs: A reception that makes a confident first impression
A private director’s cabin with plenty of storage
Open workstations with personal storage for every desk
A boardroom that seats the full leadership team
approach: We built the whole floor around warm, natural tones — travertine-coloured flooring, oak and cream laminates — with sage, terracotta and teal used sparingly as accents.

The reception counter is clad in walnut and backed by a stone-finish feature wall. In the cabin, a full-height storage wall with lit niches keeps files out of sight. Workstations carry built-in pedestals in sage and terracotta, and the boardroom table sits on a sculpted, angled base.
Every desk, counter and storage unit was made in our factory, with laminates and edge banding applied in-house.

projects.title: A modern technology office
projects.spaces: Glass cabins · Workstations · Boardroom · MD cabin · Training room · Reception
projects.made: Workstations, storage, panelling, display units, reception counter
projects.brief: A technology company moving to a larger floor needed room for a growing team, with clear zones for focused work, meetings and training — while keeping the whole floor bright.
needs: Glass cabins and meeting rooms that don’t block the light
Dense, comfortable workstation clusters with storage
A boardroom and an MD cabin with a premium finish
A training room that can be rearranged
A reception and waiting lounge for visitors
approach: Frameless glass partitions divide the floor without closing it in. A quiet palette of grey carpet and white surfaces lets walnut accents carry the warmth.

The boardroom is wrapped in walnut panelling with cove lighting; the MD cabin pairs a walnut desk with backlit display units. The training room uses movable desks and a green pin-up wall for workshops.
Workstations, storage, panelling and display joinery were made and finished in our own factory.

projects.title: An industrial-style creative office
projects.spaces: Lounge · Café corner · Glass meeting room · Studio
projects.made: Timber slat features, storage, workstations, planters
projects.brief: A creative team wanted a relaxed, open workplace where people could meet informally, brainstorm on the walls and still find a quiet corner to focus.
needs: A lounge for informal meetings and breaks
A glass meeting room that stays connected to the floor
Collaborative workstations with whiteboard walls
Greenery and warmth to soften an exposed ceiling
approach: We kept the ceiling services exposed and paired them with warm timber slats, soft seating and planters, so the space feels like a studio rather than an office.
Black-framed glass defines the meeting room, whiteboard walls turn the studio into a working surface, and a small café corner gives people somewhere to step away.
Slat panels, storage and workstations were made in our factory to fit the floor exactly.

projects.title: A compact working office
projects.made: Workstations, overhead storage, conference room panelling
projects.brief: A busy team needed to fit more people into a modest floor plate without the office feeling cramped.
needs: As many workstations as the floor could comfortably hold
Overhead storage to keep desks clear
A conference room for client meetings
approach: Long workstation runs make efficient use of the floor, and overhead cabinets take storage off the desks.
The conference room gets a timber ceiling feature and wall panelling, with a glass partition that borrows light from the office.
All workstations and storage were built in our factory to the measured floor plan.

projects.title: An operations office with a prayer niche
projects.spaces: Admin workstations · Records wall · Entrance niche
projects.made: Storage cabinets, records shelving, slat panels, prayer niche
projects.brief: An operations team handling a lot of paperwork needed serious storage — and the owners wanted a calm prayer space at the entrance.
needs: Generous cabinets and open shelving for files and records
Practical, durable workstations
A dedicated prayer niche that greets people as they arrive
approach: We lined the walls with a mix of grey cabinets and timber shelving, so records are organised and easy to reach.
At the entrance, a backlit Om niche sits within timber slats — a quiet, respectful moment before the working floor.
Cabinets, shelving and the niche were made and finished in our own factory.

projects.title: A complete family home
projects.spaces: Living · Foyer · Kitchen · 4 bedrooms · Pooja room
projects.made: TV wall, foyer unit, kitchen, wardrobes, study desks, pooja room
projects.brief: A family moving into their new home wanted every room designed together — calm, light and full of storage — with each child’s room feeling like their own.
needs: A living room with a feature TV wall and soft lighting
A foyer with seating and shoe storage
A kitchen with display and concealed storage
Full-height wardrobes in every bedroom
Personal rooms for the children, with study desks
A traditional pooja room
approach: We kept a quiet palette of cream, greige and walnut throughout, so the home reads as one. The living room centres on a marble-finish TV wall with a floating console and cove lighting.

The foyer combines a mirror, bench and tall shoe storage. Bedrooms each get full-height wardrobes with dresser niches; the girl’s room is in blush pink and the child’s room in sage, both with study desks. The pooja room has carved wooden doors and a temple mandapam.
Wardrobes, the kitchen, the TV wall and the pooja room joinery were all made in our factory.

projects.title: An open-plan home with an island kitchen
projects.made: TV unit, display shelving, island kitchen, slat screen
projects.brief: The owners wanted their kitchen, dining and living to work as one sociable space, so whoever is cooking stays part of the conversation.
needs: An island kitchen open to dining and living
A TV unit with display shelving
A screen that separates without closing off
approach: A grey island with a white counter anchors the kitchen and looks straight onto the dining table and living room.
In the living room, a slatted timber TV unit with display shelves brings warmth, and timber slats screen the stair without blocking light.
The kitchen, TV unit and slat screen were made in our factory.

projects.title: A sage green kitchen
projects.brief: The homeowners wanted a kitchen with some colour — but soft enough to live with every day.
needs: An efficient L-shaped layout
A tall unit for the fridge
Easy-clean, hard-wearing surfaces
approach: Sage lower cabinets are balanced by cream uppers and a black granite counter, with glass-front uppers to display everyday pieces.
Under-cabinet lighting keeps the counter bright, and a tall unit frames the fridge.
Every cabinet was made, laminated and edge-banded in our factory.

projects.title: A warm beige L-shaped kitchen
projects.brief: A family wanted a warm, welcoming kitchen with a spot for quick breakfasts.
needs: An L-shaped layout around the window
A breakfast counter
Display storage for glassware
approach: Warm beige shutters, glass-front uppers and soft under-cabinet lighting give the kitchen a calm glow.
A breakfast counter extends the run, with a pendant light above.
Cabinets and counter joinery were made in our factory.

projects.title: A grey island kitchen
projects.brief: The owners wanted a modern kitchen with an island for prep and casual meals.
needs: A central island with open shelving
Tall units for built-in oven and appliances
Plenty of drawer storage
approach: Grey shutters with a white counter keep the look clean and contemporary. The island adds prep space and open shelves.
Tall units house the built-in oven, and black glass uppers add depth.
The island and every cabinet were made in our factory.

projects.title: Graphite modular kitchens
projects.made: Cabinets, tall appliance units, open shelving
projects.brief: Two busy households wanted hard-working kitchens with a dark, practical finish that hides everyday wear.
needs: Maximum counter and storage space
A tall unit for microwave and appliances
Good task lighting
approach: Graphite shutters with dark stone counters give both kitchens a bold, durable finish.
One kitchen runs in a U-shape with an open shelf; the other in an L-shape with a tall appliance unit and under-cabinet lighting.
All cabinets were made and edge-banded in our factory.

projects.title: Pooja rooms in wood and light
projects.made: Jali screens, timber battens, pooja cabinet
projects.brief: Two families wanted a dedicated pooja space — one as a feature of the home, one fitted neatly into the dining area.
needs: A screen that defines the pooja space but lets light through
Lighting that gives the shrine a warm glow
Storage for lamps and pooja items
approach: In the first home, a backlit jali screen and timber-batten ceiling frame a marble-finish wall. In the second, a compact cabinet with frosted glass doors and a lit shelf sits beside the dining area.
Both were machined and finished in our own workshop.
